service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , CODE.TEXT1 AS "POSITION" FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON USMT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCODE CODE ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = 'M230' AND CODE.CODE = USMT.POSITION WHERE USMT.SIGN_STATUS = ${SIGN_STATUS} AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND ( 1 = 1 AND USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR USMT.USER_ID LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' ) AND $S{F_STATUS} IN( 'A', USMT.USER_TYPE ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' ORDER BY USMT.USER_ID
